glosses: Traurigkeit über den Verlust einer Person oder auch Sache (Trauer) zeigen

examples.text: „Rosalie starb einen milden Tod, betrauert von allen, die sie kannten.“
„Armer Bruno! Ich habe sein Schicksal recht betrauert.“

translations.source_sense_description: Traurigkeit über den Verlust einer Person oder auch Sache (Trauer) zeigen

glosses: To cause sorrow or distress to.

examples.text: Thy maidens griev'd themselves at my concern.

glosses: To feel very sad about; to mourn; to sorrow for.
To submit or file a grievance (about).

examples.text: Even if the executive director rules against the employee on appeal, the employee can still grieve the termination to the superintendent followed by an appeal to the … Board of Trustees.

glosses: A governor of a town or province.
A manager or steward, e.g. of a farm.

examples.text:
1559-1566, John Knox, History of the Reformation in Scotland
[A prince] is nothing but a servant, overseer, or grieve, and not the head, which is a title belonging only to Christ.
[T]heir children were horsewhipped by the grieve when found trespassing; […]

glosses: li ber ketin, li ber xwe ketin, xemgîn bûn, dilkeser bûn
